description_zh: 调用本接口删除动图信息
name: DeleteDynamicImage

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video associated with the animated stickers that you want to delete. You can obtain the video ID by using one of the following methods:
For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
Obtain the video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
After the video is uploaded, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的动图所关联的视频ID。视频ID可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of animated sticker IDs. The animated sticker ID is the value of the DynamicImageId response parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180958.html operation.

Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 10 IDs.
If you do not specify this parameter, all animated stickers associated with the specified VideoId are deleted. However, if the video has more than 10 animated stickers, the deletion request is rejected
parameters.help_zh:
动图文件ID列表。动图文件ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180958.html接口返回参数DynamicImageId的值。

多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持10个ID。
如果不传该参数，将按VideoId删除视频下的所有动图，但是如果视频下的动图数量超过10个，将拒绝删除请求
parameters.name: dynamic_image_ids
